description: Library of subsystem failure modes for robustness/contingency testing. Standard reliability-engineering constructs (analogous to OEI/one-engine-inoperative analysis) — used to stress-test the power-split strategy, not to model any offensive capability.

failure_modes.description: Complete loss of turboshaft power output.
failure_modes.recommended_response: Switch to battery-primary, reduce power demand to best-glide/loiter setting, initiate return-to-base.

failure_modes.description: Generator can no longer convert shaft power to usable electrical power (engine still running mechanically).
failure_modes.recommended_response: Same electrical effect as engine_flameout even though engine keeps running; battery becomes sole electrical source.

failure_modes.description: Partial loss of usable battery capacity from a failed cell group.
failure_modes.recommended_response: Recompute remaining endurance with derated capacity; tighten SoC reserve floor.

failure_modes.description: One electric motor in a multi-motor configuration fails or is shut down.

effect.note: Assumes 4-motor baseline; scale proportionally if motor_count differs.

failure_modes.recommended_response: Redistribute power across remaining motors; may require reduced airspeed/altitude.

failure_modes.description: Battery temperature approaches thermal limit, forcing automatic power derate.
failure_modes.recommended_response: Shift power split toward engine; reduce climb rate or speed to lower current draw.
No propulsion impact; flagged here since it affects mission-abort logic in events.json.

failure_modes.description: Loss of command/control or telemetry datalink.
failure_modes.recommended_response: Trigger lost-link RTB (return-to-base) profile per states.json ABORT transition.
